0.body: Bazel rules for Aldec Riviera-PRO , a mixed-language (Verilog / SystemVerilog / VHDL) HDL simulator. The public surface is four rules over three providers: riviera_library — compile a verilog_library / vhdl_library DAG into ONE self-contained Riviera library. riviera_hdl_testbench — package an HDL testbench top for elaboration. riviera_cocotb_testbench — package a Python cocotb testbench (auto-locates libcocotbvpi_aldec.so, wires the VPI). riviera_sim_test — elaborate + simulate a testbench under vsimsa. Cocotb-agnostic — only reads RivieraTestbenchInfo. riviera_toolchain — bind the eight Riviera executables (vsimsa/vsim/alib/alog/acom/asim/vmap/acdb) to the toolchain type the rules resolve. Everything else — coverage collection under bazel coverage, //tools/acdb2lcov for ACDB -> lcov conversion — is designed around those rules.
0.title: rules_aldec_riviera

1.body: Riviera-PRO is a commercial simulator; this repo does not distribute it. rules_aldec_riviera provides the Bazel rules and the toolchain type contract — how Riviera actually reaches your Bazel actions is deployment infrastructure and lives entirely in your own repo.

11.body: load("@rules_aldec_riviera//riviera:riviera_sim_test.bzl", "riviera_sim_test") riviera_sim_test(name, data, env, exec_requirements, generics, jobs, sim_opts, testbench) Elaborate + simulate a Riviera testbench under vsimsa as a Bazel test. Takes exactly one testbench — either an riviera_hdl_testbench or an riviera_cocotb_testbench, both of which provide RivieraTestbenchInfo. The rule is oblivious to the HDL-vs-cocotb distinction: everything cocotb-specific (the -pli VPI path, MODULE / TOPLEVEL / COCOTB_TOPLEVEL_LANG env, merged Python PyInfo) is packaged inside the testbench provider and forwarded verbatim. Rule ↔ launcher hand-off: The rule builds a ctx.actions.args() bundle describing everything the launcher needs (tool rlocation keys, library name, top, generics, sim opts, coverage flag, cocotb config) and writes it to a multiline param file via ctx.actions.write(content = args). It exposes exactly one env var — RIVIERA_ARGS_FILE_RLOC — whose value is the args file's runfiles-library key. The launcher (//tools/riviera_launcher) reads the env, resolves the args file via runfiles.Rlocation, argparse's it, resolves every *_rloc field to an absolute path, constructs the .do at runtime, and hands vsimsa the absolute path. Coverage kicks in automatically under bazel coverage via ctx.coverage_instrumented(): the launcher adds -coverage sbceam -acdb to the .do, renders html + text into $TEST_UNDECLARED_OUTPUTS_DIR, and converts text → lcov via //tools/acdb2lcov for $COVERAGE_OUTPUT_FILE. ATTRIBUTES Name Description Type Mandatory Default name A unique name for this target. Name required data Runtime data (memory init files, etc.) staged into runfiles. List of labels optional [] env Extra environment variables for the test action. Overrides anything the rule derives automatically (e.g. COCOTB_TOPLEVEL_LANG for a mixed-language design with a VHDL top). Dictionary: String -> String optional {} exec_requirements Extra execution_requirements merged on top of the defaults (resources:riviera_license=1, plus requires-network when the toolchain says so). Use to override license slot count, force no-remote-exec, request a named resource pool, etc. Dictionary: String -> String optional {} generics Elaboration-time parameters / generics (mapped to -g <name>=<value>). Dictionary: String -> String optional {} jobs CPU slots requested for the test. -1 (default) inherits the toolchain's jobs field; 0 explicitly means no hint; N > 0 adds cpu:N to testing.ExecutionInfo.requirements. Only hints the scheduler — pass any Riviera-specific parallel simulator flags (-j, -threads, -mfcu, etc.) through sim_opts. Integer optional -1 sim_opts Extra arguments forwarded to asim. List of strings optional [] testbench A target providing RivieraTestbenchInfo — either a riviera_hdl_testbench or a riviera_cocotb_testbench. Label required

13.body: load("@rules_aldec_riviera//riviera:riviera_toolchain.bzl", "riviera_toolchain") riviera_toolchain(name, acdb, acom, alib, alog, asim, env, jobs, requires_network, version, vmap, vsim, vsimsa) Declares an Aldec Riviera-PRO toolchain by binding one executable per Riviera tool. Each tool attr takes an executable target that resolves to the corresponding Riviera binary. In the ideal case that's a hermetic toolchain that vendors the whole install into the Bazel action graph; in practice it can be anything Bazel can exec — the toolchain only cares that each attr resolves to something that behaves like the named tool. Load-bearing tools — invoked directly across the Bazel action boundary, so their attrs are mandatory = True: vsimsa — every riviera_library compile action and every riviera_sim_test launcher call. acdb — invoked by riviera_sim_test's launcher during bazel coverage post-processing. Discoverability tools — vsim, alib, alog, acom, asim, vmap — run inside vsimsa's TCL interpreter today and never cross the Bazel boundary. Exposed here so future rules or downstream consumers have a place to bind if they ever need a Bazel-visible path to those binaries. ATTRIBUTES Name Description Type Mandatory Default name A unique name for this target. Name required acdb Executable invoked as acdb. MANDATORY — the rules call this tool directly. Label required acom Executable invoked as acom. Optional — currently runs inside vsimsa's TCL interpreter and doesn't cross the Bazel action boundary. Bind if a future rule needs a Bazel-visible path. Label optional "@rules_aldec_riviera//riviera/private/shims:acom.sh" alib Executable invoked as alib. Optional — currently runs inside vsimsa's TCL interpreter and doesn't cross the Bazel action boundary. Bind if a future rule needs a Bazel-visible path. Label optional "@rules_aldec_riviera//riviera/private/shims:alib.sh" alog Executable invoked as alog. Optional — currently runs inside vsimsa's TCL interpreter and doesn't cross the Bazel action boundary. Bind if a future rule needs a Bazel-visible path. Label optional "@rules_aldec_riviera//riviera/private/shims:alog.sh" asim Executable invoked as asim. Optional — currently runs inside vsimsa's TCL interpreter and doesn't cross the Bazel action boundary. Bind if a future rule needs a Bazel-visible path. Label optional "@rules_aldec_riviera//riviera/private/shims:asim.sh" env Extra env vars applied to every action that resolves this toolchain. Dictionary: String -> String optional {} jobs Default CPU-count hint for actions and tests that resolve this toolchain. -1 (default) means no hint — Bazel schedules however it likes; 0 also means no hint; N > 0 requests N CPUs. Per-target jobs = -1 (the rule default) inherits this value. Integer optional -1 requires_network Set True when Riviera actions need network access (FlexLM license server). Boolean optional False version Toolchain version identifier for diagnostics. String optional "" vmap Executable invoked as vmap. Optional — currently runs inside vsimsa's TCL interpreter and doesn't cross the Bazel action boundary. Bind if a future rule needs a Bazel-visible path. Label optional "@rules_aldec_riviera//riviera/private/shims:vmap.sh" vsim Executable invoked as vsim. Optional — currently runs inside vsimsa's TCL interpreter and doesn't cross the Bazel action boundary. Bind if a future rule needs a Bazel-visible path. Label optional "@rules_aldec_riviera//riviera/private/shims:vsim.sh" vsimsa Executable invoked as vsimsa. MANDATORY — the rules call this tool directly. Label required

14.body: A pure-Python tool that converts Aldec's acdb report -xml output to lcov .info format. Usable independently of the Bazel rules — the same code powers riviera_sim_test's coverage post-processing.
14.title: acdb2lcov

15.body: Binary : //tools/acdb2lcov:acdb2lcov — a py_binary (from @rules_venv//python:py_binary.bzl) with the CLI entrypoint. py_binary also exposes the module for direct import by any downstream py_binary / py_test / py_library that depends on it. Mypy walks the sources directly via the aspect, so downstream consumers get inline type-hint checking without extra opt-in.
15.title: Where it lives

16.title: Python usage

17.body: bazel run @rules_aldec_riviera//tools/acdb2lcov:acdb2lcov -- \ --input coverage_report.xml --output coverage.info Both flags take filesystem paths.
17.title: CLI usage

18.body:
Riviera exposes coverage as acdb report -xml <acdb> -o <out.xml>. The XML schema Aldec ships isn't publicly documented; parse_acdb_xml walks a best-effort mapping: <coverage> <file path="/abs/path/to/foo.sv"> <statement line="10" hits="5"/> <branch line="11" block="0" branch="0" hits="0"/> </file>
</coverage> If a Riviera release changes the element / attribute names, adjust _iter_file_coverage in tools/acdb2lcov/acdb2lcov.py — every parser change stays local to that function. Coverage types beyond <statement> and <branch> (Covergroup, Expression, Condition, FSM, Toggle, Assertion, Path) are silently skipped — they're not representable in lcov and the launcher's flow doesn't ask acdb to emit them.

3.title: Author a toolchain

4.body: Four public rules, three providers. Every rule is single-purpose and speaks one provider — no rule holds "am I in cocotb mode?" state. Rule Produces Consumes riviera_library RivieraLibraryInfo VerilogInfo / VhdlInfo riviera_hdl_testbench RivieraTestbenchInfo RivieraLibraryInfo riviera_cocotb_testbench RivieraTestbenchInfo + PyInfo RivieraLibraryInfo, PyInfo riviera_sim_test (a bazel test) RivieraTestbenchInfo riviera_toolchain RivieraToolchainInfo 8 tool shims Anything that produces RivieraLibraryInfo (pre-built vendor library, imported UVM archive, etc.) is a drop-in for the testbench rules' library attr; anything that produces RivieraTestbenchInfo is a drop-in for riviera_sim_test.testbench. No sim-rule surgery required to accommodate new sources of either provider. riviera_library — compile a verilog_library / vhdl_library DAG into one Riviera library. riviera_testbench — two rules: riviera_hdl_testbench (SV/VHDL top drives DUT) and riviera_cocotb_testbench (Python drives DUT via VPI). Both feed riviera_sim_test. riviera_sim_test — elaborate + simulate a testbench under vsimsa. Automatic coverage under bazel coverage. riviera_toolchain — bind Riviera executables to the toolchain type consumed by the rules above.

6.body: load("@rules_aldec_riviera//riviera:riviera_library.bzl", "riviera_library") riviera_library(name, deps, srcs, compile_opts, defines, exec_requirements, jobs, library_name) Compile the full transitive HDL DAG into ONE self-contained Aldec Riviera library. deps takes verilog_library / vhdl_library targets (anything providing VerilogInfo or VhdlInfo). The rule walks the whole reachable source graph — own srcs + hdrs, transitive .deps, and cross-language .vhdl_deps / .verilog_deps — and compiles it in one alib/alog/acom invocation via a generated vsimsa .do script. Output is one TreeArtifact directory; downstream consumers (testbench rules, riviera_sim_test) vmap it by the logical library name. srcs is an optional escape hatch for HDL files that only make sense inside this Riviera library (a Riviera-specific stub, a compile-time wrapper) and don't warrant their own HDL-library target. Runs through //tools/riviera_wrapper so vsimsa's HOME is isolated per-action (~/.aldec/ doesn't bleed into the user's real home) and stdout is buffered — nothing streams unless the action fails or a # Error/# Fatal slips past vsimsa's exit code. Users compose library boundaries by wiring multiple riviera_library targets together via other consumers, not by cross-linking riviera_library deps. ATTRIBUTES Name Description Type Mandatory Default name A unique name for this target. Name required deps verilog_library / vhdl_library targets. The full reachable source graph (own srcs+hdrs, transitive deps, cross-language deps) is compiled into this Riviera library. List of labels optional [] srcs Optional raw HDL files (.v/.sv/.vh/.svh/.vhd/.vhdl) unique to this Riviera library. Most callers leave this empty and put their sources in a verilog_library/vhdl_library referenced via deps. List of labels optional [] compile_opts Extra flags forwarded to alog/acom. List of strings optional [] defines +define+FOO=bar macros passed to alog (Verilog only). List of strings optional [] exec_requirements Extra execution_requirements merged on top of the defaults (which are resources:riviera_license=1 and — when the toolchain has requires_network=True — requires-network). Use to override the license slot count, force no-remote-exec, tag a specific resource pool, etc. Dictionary: String -> String optional {} jobs CPU slots to request from Bazel's local scheduler. -1 (default) inherits the toolchain's jobs field; 0 explicitly means no hint; N > 0 maps to resource_set = {'cpu': N}. Only hints the scheduler — pass any Riviera-specific parallel flags (e.g. -j, -mfcu) via compile_opts. Integer optional -1 library_name Logical Riviera library name. Defaults to the target's label name. String optional ""

8.body: load("@rules_aldec_riviera//riviera:riviera_testbench.bzl", "riviera_cocotb_testbench") riviera_cocotb_testbench(name, deps, library, module, top) A cocotb testbench — top is the HDL DUT, module is the Python cocotb test module that drives it via VPI. Produces RivieraTestbenchInfo with every cocotb-specific derivation resolved at testbench-definition time: top_unit — the unqualified unit name for cocotb's TOPLEVEL env. cocotb_toplevel_lang — derived from library.language (mixed defaults to verilog; override via the sim rule's env attr). vpi_lib — the libcocotbvpi_aldec.so located inside deps runfiles; the sim rule injects -pli <path> into asim. Also provides PyInfo (merged from deps via py_venv_common) so riviera_sim_test can pull the whole Python graph into its own venv with one create_dep_info call. When cocotb loads embedded Python via the VPI shared object, that Python sees cocotb in its sys.path. ATTRIBUTES Name Description Type Mandatory Default name A unique name for this target. Name required deps PyInfo targets folded into the launcher venv. One must transitively provide cocotb (so libcocotbvpi_aldec.so lands in runfiles). List of labels required library The riviera_library containing the DUT. Label required module cocotb test module name (goes to MODULE env at test time). String required top HDL DUT unit name (unqualified). The rule prepends the library's logical name for asim. String required
8.title: riviera_cocotb_testbench

9.body: load("@rules_aldec_riviera//riviera:riviera_testbench.bzl", "riviera_hdl_testbench") riviera_hdl_testbench(name, library, top) A plain HDL testbench — top is a SystemVerilog / VHDL module that drives the DUT and calls $finish / std.env.finish. Produces RivieraTestbenchInfo with cocotb_module="" and vpi_lib=None. riviera_sim_test reads that provider and elaborates <library>.<top> under vsimsa; the HDL testbench itself terminates the simulation. Splitting cocotb and HDL into two rules — instead of one rule with an optional-cocotb attr — keeps every attr on each rule always-applicable and moves the "am I in cocotb mode?" decision to testbench-definition time rather than sim-invocation time. ATTRIBUTES Name Description Type Mandatory Default name A unique name for this target. Name required library The riviera_library containing the DUT + testbench HDL. Label required top HDL top-level unit name (unqualified). The rule prepends the library's logical name for asim. String required
9.title: riviera_hdl_testbench
